```yaml
name: Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [ develop, main ]
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ develop, main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Go 1.26
      uses: actions/setup-go@v2
      with:
        go-version: '1.26'

    - name: Run go fix for modernization
      run: go fix ./...

    - name: Run tests without race detector
      run: make test

    - name: Run tests with race detector
      if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.ref == 'refs/tags/v*.*.*'
      run: make test-race

    - name: Lint code
      run: make lint

    - name: Check for gofix drift
      run: make gofix-drift-check

    - name: Run migrations parity checks
      run: make migrate-parity-checks
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file implements the requested changes for the `autobrr/qui` repository. It sets up Go 1.26, runs `go fix` for modernization, and includes various test and linting steps tailored to the project's needs. The workflow is configured to skip the race detector on pull requests and run it on `develop` and `main` pushes and tags. Additionally, it includes a step to check for `go fix` drift and run migrations parity checks.
